title: 328 Claude skills installed. I used 18.
topic: Audit of Shazim's own Claude Code logs (60 days): 328 skills installed, 18 ever loaded (9 more built-in/project skills were also used); the 25 tools that did the work, organised like a company
author: Shazim Khan
notes: Layout cloned from a Charlie Hills reference (references/claude-team-42), words and data are Shazim's own. Every count is real: tool calls in ~/.claude/projects logs, 28 Aug to 27 Oct 2026, this Mac only (method + script in research.md). New template org-chart (rotation: C1-C4 used model-cards, agent-recipes, level-series, slack-case). Slide 1 ships as exports/01-cover.mp4 on Instagram/TikTok; the PNG is the LinkedIn PDF page.
